prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1147; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. I'll be recording this statement. Is that alright with you?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on the main road in Pearland, heading toward the shopping center. It was a weekday afternoon and traffic was moderate.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I had slowed down because the light ahead had turned yellow and the cars in front of me were stopping. I was completely stopped at the light when I felt the impact.

Q: Was your vehicle struck from behind?

A: Yes. The other car hit me in the rear. My head snapped forward and then back. It happened very fast.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They apologized and said they had looked down at their phone for a second. They didn't seem to be hurt badly.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or the emergency room after the accident?

A: I went to urgent care that same evening because my neck was really stiff and I had a headache. They diagnosed me with whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some pain medication.

Q: Are you still having symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck still hurts when I turn my head, and I get stiffness in my shoulders by the end of the day. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed a few days right after the accident, and I've been working a modified schedule since then because sitting at my desk for long periods is uncomfortable.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes our statement.
